ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: advantage_gap_logsigmoid_weighted_sum_normalized_loss_v2
ir.intuition: Shift aggregation from mean to normalized weighted sum, scaling pairwise log-probability differences by advantage gap norm and weighting losses without averaging, to increase sensitivity to weight magnitude while retaining margin structure.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon = 1e-6
norm_adv_gap = max(norm(advantage_gap), epsilon)
diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm_adv_gap
loss = -logsigmoid(diff) * weight
return sum(loss) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    norm_adv_gap = ops.maximum(ops.norm(advantage_gap), epsilon)
    diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_adv_gap)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    weight_sum = ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon)
    return ops.div(loss_sum, weight_sum)
